digest.component_or_area: completion recovery and close-gate failure messaging
propositions: A ticket exceeding the 24,000-char context bound cannot reach closed status without --force-close, blocking correct merged work from transitioning to closed
The recovery failure path incorrectly attributes step-budget exhaustion to a missing agents extra when the exception lacks a cause field, hiding the actual remedy
The _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS (32,000) and _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS (24,000) bounds are mutually incoherent: criteria can be larger than the context cap yet pass all criteria bounds then fail on context

Raising the context cap to 100,000 chars and eliding nothing covers observed real tickets (34,282 and 41,595 chars) while maintaining per-criterion re-send cost control and keeping the criteria budget at or below the context budget
